prompt: A single short chain of a few round flat discs floating flat on the open sea, seen from slightly above: thin round wooden discs lying on the water in one gently curved row, each disc joined to the next by one short straight link, the row receding slightly into the distance, and the last disc, the nearest and largest one, filled with cobalt blue #3d6fd9 and marked with one bold off-white tick, a simple V-shaped stroke. The other discs and the links are drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading, their faces plain and blank; only the last disc is blue. From the chain, concentric ripples spread out across the water surface, drawn as fine engraved off-white lines in the water itself: wide flattened ellipses seen in perspective, much wider than tall, the nearer arcs larger and bolder, the farther arcs thinner and fading into the wave lines, dying out well before the left third of the image. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, bathymetric contour lines with small depth soundings drawn as tiny dots, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no gradient, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. The engraved sea fills the whole wide image edge to edge. The chain is medium-small and sits in the right half of the image with water all around it; the entire left third of the image is completely calm open water with nothing in it, only quiet engraved wave lines. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of cobalt blue #3d6fd9 on the last disc only.
